title: Card Identification v2 (Pokémon first)
authoredBy: Claude Code (operator session 2026-10-11); not yet run through Build Spec / Challenge Council

operatorDecisions.P1: Stop patching v1; write this spec
operatorDecisions.P3: Identification budget up to $0.04 per card
operatorDecisions.P4: Operator review of ed919c12 and 7025bfdd done

goal: Identify a scanned Pokémon card to the exact printing (TCGdex id) from the master images, with a confidence that means something, and a Review screen where confirming or correcting takes seconds. Measure every change against a fixed truth set before it ships.
passBar: Golden ed919c12: top-1 exact printing >= 24/25, top-3 25/25
Zero confident-wrong (no wrong card marked HIGH)
Unit 0045 flagged as possible double feed
Mean cost <= $0.04 per card, recorded per card
The 5 unverified truth rows confirmed by the operator before the bar is declared passed
constraints: AGENTS.md in full: provenance on every derived field; inferred never stored as verified; raw captures immutable; needs_review never auto-cleared; confirmed identities never silently overwritten; adapters swappable; no TCGplayer API
TypeScript + zod contracts first; apps consume packages; packages never reach the DB
v2 behind VIP_SCAN_ID_V2=1 until the pass bar is met; v1 stays default and is not patched further
Every provider response (catalog JSON, official image, vision reply) is a raw snapshot; results regenerable from snapshots; vision via the scan_vision cache
Per-card budget meter enforced in code (cap $0.04, VIP_SCAN_ID_BUDGET_USD); spend recorded in provenance
Sports, MTG and comics out of scope and must not regress (v1 path unchanged)
No table or column beyond the file plan; report gaps instead
pipeline: O1 strip reader: crop the identifier strip from the full-resolution master (region per OCR profile), Tesseract psm 7 at 3x, parse SETCODE [LANG] NNN[/TTT], map via TCGdex set.abbreviation.official + reviewed overrides; vision on the strip crop only if OCR does not parse
Candidates: union of strip exact lookup, existing TCGdex name/number search, confirmed VIP assets; max 5
O2 picture check: official image (TCGdex image + /low.webp) cached as raw snapshot; dHash of the art box; pairwise vision for the top two only when within the ambiguity margin and within budget

O3 agreement confidence: HIGH = strip unique AND name agrees AND picture match; MEDIUM = two agree, none contradicts; else LOW/CONFLICT naming the disagreeing signal; thresholds are versioned constants

O4 review screen: scan beside official image; alternatives as images; search any TCGdex card; keys Enter/1-5/'/'/R; names from the catalog record; corrections write history (identity_correction), never overwrite
O5 benchmark + feedback: npm run scan:benchmark on preserved masters, read-only; each correction becomes a golden case (N2) and feeds a correction report by cause (N1)

file_plan.notes: Only module touching the image library (D1)
exact setId+localId lookup by set code; v1 search intact
correction history; was_correct from catalog key

acceptance_tests: AT-01 strip parse fixtures (PFL EN 005/094, MEE EN 003, MEG EN 124/132, JTG EN 029/159); garbage -> null
AT-02 every golden set code maps to its TCGdex set id; unknown -> null and reported
AT-03 strip PFL 005/094 resolves only to me02-005
AT-04 dHash ranks the true printing first for golden Lotad and Premium Power Pro
AT-05 HIGH requires all three signals; disagreement never HIGH; verdict names the signal
AT-06 budget cap stops escalation at $0.04, marks capped, routes to Review, records spend
AT-07 benchmark meets the pass bar and writes nothing to scan batches
AT-08 correction keeps the old identity in identity_correction; holding changes only via that path
AT-09 confirmed names come from the catalog record, never repeated-word concatenations
AT-11 sports/MTG/comics unchanged on v1; npm test green; scan tests leave DB row counts unchanged
AT-12 every catalog reply, official image and vision reply is a raw snapshot; offline benchmark replay gives the same result

open_decisions.question: Picture match method
open_decisions.recommendation: dHash + pairwise now; CLIP for sports catalog-wide search later

options: through the new correction path (keeps history)

risks: Strip position varies by era and card type; regions live in profiles
TCGdex images missing for very new sets; picture check abstains
dHash is noisier on holo/foil; ambiguity margin routes to pairwise check or Review
Vision pricing can change; meter reads model price from config
